title: Regulatory Pass-Through on Fixed Rates: Small Business Electricity Supply Terms and Conditions
content:
**Clause.** A business fixed rate under Small Business Electricity Supply may change during the term only to pass through a change in law or regulation, and only on a plan whose regulatory pass-through permission is yes. A regulatory pass-through notice must be issued at least the plan's pass-through notice days (30 calendar days on every plan) before its effective date, and the new rate applies to cycles beginning on or after the later of the stated effective date and the notice date plus 30 days. On a plan whose regulatory pass-through permission is no, the rate is guaranteed for the whole term, and any pass-through billed on it is a billing error.

## Plans and the clause

| Plan | Pass-through permitted | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12, Fixed 24, Green 24 | yes | the fixed rate may change during the term only for a change in law or regulation, on the notice terms above |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36, Green 36 | no | the rate is guaranteed for the whole term; a pass-through billed on it is a billing error |
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | no | no regulatory pass-through is permitted on this plan |

## From which cycle the new rate applies (hypothetical dates)

| Notice date | Stated effective date | Notice date plus 30 days | Later of the two | New rate applies to |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 July | 1 September | 31 July | 1 September | cycles beginning on or after 1 September |
| 10 August | 1 September | 9 September | 9 September | cycles beginning on or after 9 September |

## Points of judgement

- The only ground for a fixed-rate change during the term is a change in law or regulation; no other ground is provided.
- A pass-through line on a Fixed 36 or Green 36 agreement during its term is a billing error under this clause.
